data.one_liner: Embed YouTube videos and shorts in Flutter using an InAppWebView.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to embed YouTube videos and YouTube Shorts directly into Flutter applications using an InAppWebView. Provides customizable options such as autoplay, mute, aspect ratio customization, programmatic playback controls, and event listeners.
use_when: You need to embed YouTube videos or Shorts into your Flutter application across multiple platforms.
You require advanced playback controls and event handling for YouTube embeds.
avoid_when: You are playing raw video files or streaming non-YouTube video sources.
You want a native video player without web-view overhead.
strengths: Supports YouTube Shorts and normal videos with custom aspect ratios.
Offers programmatic control like play, pause, seek, and mute/unmute.
Includes advanced event listeners for state changes, time tracking, and seeking.
weaknesses: Relies on InAppWebView behind the scenes rather than a purely native player implementation.
Requires platform-specific configuration for Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and configuring NSAppTransportSecurity and Info.plist settings on iOS.
